summary: Completed API regression and Razorpay approval/payment guard testing; public browser verification was blocked because the configured preview URL serves an unrelated preview shell.

integration_issues.issue: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL points to crop-tool-hub.preview.emergentagent.com, which serves an unrelated preview/wake-up page instead of AgriRent Pro; browser selectors for the app are unavailable.

action_items: Fix preview/deployment routing and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL so the public URL serves AgriRent Pro frontend/backend.
Rerun browser approval, Pay now, checkout error, and mobile responsive tests after routing is corrected.
critical_code_review_comments: Payment API correctly keeps Razorpay secret server-side and uses paise conversion. Frontend checkout script is dynamically loaded and errors are surfaced through toast.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-prefixed rental during payment regression; it remains in demo database because no delete endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: API tests passed: browse/filter, rental persistence, unavailable rejection, approval, unapproved order rejection, Razorpay order amount/key response, and mismatched order verification. Public UI could not load AgriRent Pro.
rca of the issue: The frontend build reads process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and the configured external hostname serves a different preview application. This makes the deployed browser flow impossible to exercise and likely prevents frontend API calls from reaching AgriRent Pro.
